title: Amazingly Sweet Ukrainian Tomato Kebabs
description: Sweet and gooey Ukrainian dish featuring grilled tomatoes, perfect for a romantic evening, and is FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium heat, about 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread tomatoes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each tomato.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, honey, garlic-infused oil, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the tomatoes.
Grill the tomato kebabs for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are tender and lightly charred.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Consider serving with a side of grilled meats or vegetables for a complete meal.
